inventory.anchor: CanvasRenderingContext2D::DrawOrMeasureText (TextMetrics return); also CreatePattern (2 hunks) and a comment-only block near GetImageBuffer
inventory.notes: The DrawOrMeasureText hunk is about 45 logic lines (vertical metrics rounding, baseline switch, MakeUnique call). It can move into an own file taking a small input struct, leaving a one-line hook that returns a Maybe<TextMetrics>. The CreatePattern hunks (source snapshot read through the element) belong to canvas-noise-projection, not to text metrics. The 30-line comment block 'a 2D canvas reads back exactly as drawn' is documentation of a decision with no code; it and the removed coverage-ladder history should live in our files. Includes StealthDeclarationGate.h, StealthBundleFontList.h and StaticPrefs_zoom.h, but no pref is read in this diff; StealthEngineActive() (gfx/thebes/StealthDeclarationGate.h:42) reads zoom.stealth.fpp.hw_seed (> 0 means active); verified, not read in this diff itself.

verifier.why: Two evidence quotes had the wrong indentation (8 spaces, not 6); notes now say which pref StealthEngineActive() reads.
